findings.detail: Phase 1 changes `MigrationFacts` to require `rebindablePhaseIds` and changes `planMigrationClose` to enforce the rebind refusal, but `req-close.ts` is explicitly deferred to Phase 2. Thus the Phase-1 commit cannot meet its declared `typecheck0` exit condition: the existing `req-close.ts` call lacks the required fact. If Phase 1 instead supplies a temporary empty/default value to compile, the normal path `stale dev-complete + all unbound phases rebindable → req:close --migrate --run` reaches migration stamping before Phase 2, bypassing the required human-confirmed `req:rebind` path. This violates the independent-phase contract and R2/fail-closed boundary. Move the fact computation and wiring into Phase 1 (with the applicable e2e), or defer activating the new migration branch until the same phase that wires the real fact.

next_action: Revise the phase split so the Phase-1 migration predicate receives real rebindability facts whenever it is activated, then resubmit the design review.
